Analysing equipment condition trends and identifying developing defects before they result in equipment failure or production loss. Preparing equipment condition reports and providing clear recommendations to Maintenance and Operations teams. Coordinating specialist condition monitoring and NDT service providers where internal capability is not available. Ensuring condition monitoring instruments and specialist equipment are correctly maintained, calibrated and fit for purpose. Maintaining accurate equipment condition history, inspection records, reports and reliability information within the appropriate systems. Reliability, Asset Management or Reliability Centred Maintenance qualifications will be an added advantage.
